summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments on PR #416, then perform comprehensive documentation updates on a docs branch including DEFERRED.md pruning, FEATURES.md updates, README refresh, filesystem spec creation, and docs/ folder audit.
summary.outcome: PR #416 review comments resolved (4 threads: 2 fixed, 1 not applicable, 1 doc fix). Docs branch PR #419 created with updated DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md, new FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md, and audited/updated docs/ folder. Codebase map (CONCERNS.md, TESTING.md) refreshed. Phases 38 and 39 added to roadmap.

repo: Grafana Faro is the implemented error tracking and remote log shipping solution — not Sentry or Datadog. Session replay was never in scope (anti-feature for zero-knowledge product).
Vault v1 legacy columns were removed when staging was reset; the full schema migration (1700000000000-FullSchema.ts) is the current baseline and does not include them.
FUSE unit tests are intentionally absent — FUSE is OS integration plumbing best tested at the Desktop E2E level, not mocked at unit level.
Linux FUSE uses the same `fuse` feature flag as macOS: NFC-normalized, case-sensitive lookups via libfuse3.
TEE republish failures (0/15 ECIES decryption failures) are caused by stale enrollments using the old TEE public key from before the Phala CVM migration. 477 new enrollments are healthy.
AES-CTR is used for large file encryption (audio and video), not just video. AES-GCM is for small files. Uploads do NOT always use AES-GCM.
The duplicate/replacement upload path still uses encryptFile() on the main thread — Phase 37 only moved new file encryption to the Web Worker.
SDK and SDK-core packages use console.warn directly (zero-dependency constraint), bypassing Grafana Faro transport — 11+ calls bypass structured logging.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is operator config (env var), not a user-facing setting. User-configurable retention is still deferred as Phase 39.
crypto package has @cipherbox/core as a devDependency only for vault-ipns.test.ts — test-only circular dep that should have been cleaned up in Phase 19.1.
Share TTL is 48h in the codebase, not 72h as documented in FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md.
CipherBox FUSE mount is accessible via Terminal on macOS and via PowerShell/Git Bash on Windows.
14 database tables total; share_invites and pin_migrations tables were added but missing from DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md.
TEE moved from Nitro fallback to Phala Cloud CVM (Phase 35). No fallback provider option remains.
IPNS republish interval is 6h, not 3h — CLAUDE.md had a stale value.

code.finding: getWorker() and postMessage() can throw, leaking pending entries in the promise map — fixed with try/catch that rejects and removes the pending entry on failure.
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding — large files use streaming CTR encryption, not full-buffer GCM.
Batch reads all files to memory before SDK call — architectural issue, not a bug. Requires SDK contract change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array. Deferred.
Contains is_platform_special() and is_windows_special() — CodeRabbit incorrectly suggested these didn't match their documented names.
Only consumer of @cipherbox/core devDependency in crypto package. Test could use hardcoded test vectors instead to eliminate the circular dep.

workflow: When asked to prune a list for already-implemented items, verify every single item systematically rather than only checking the ones the user explicitly calls out.
Deferred items should be categorized as: implemented (remove), not in scope/anti-feature (remove), or still valid (keep with updated notes).
PR review comments from multiple automated reviewers (CodeRabbit, Copilot) often flag the same issue — triage duplicates and reply to both but fix once.
For integration test failures in CI that require a live backend, confirm they are pre-existing before treating them as blockers to commit.
When diagnosing TEE failures, check individual result success fields in the response body — HTTP 200 can still contain per-record failures.
gsd-codebase-mapper agents write documents directly; orchestrator only receives line counts and confirmations to keep context usage minimal.
Codebase map documents should be selectively refreshed rather than fully regenerated when only specific areas have changed.

friction: Initial DEFERRED.md pruning pass was shallow — only verified items the user explicitly called out rather than auditing the full list, requiring multiple correction rounds.
Edit tool reformatted markdown table widths after an edit, making subsequent targeted edits fail due to whitespace mismatches — required reading raw file content with Bash to get exact formatting.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS was initially misidentified as implementing user-configurable retention, when it is operator config — required a correction commit.
DTS circular dependency was initially removed from DEFERRED then needed to be re-added after user clarification that it was a real cleanup item never completed in Phase 19.1.
Commit subject line format rejected by pre-commit hook when using parenthetical scope notation — required lowercase subject without parens.
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines), and remove @cipherbox/core devDependency from crypto package by refactoring vault-ipns.test.ts to use hardcoded test vectors.
Phase 39: User-configurable vault parameters — bin retention period (UI setting, not operator env var), soft vs hard delete toggle, versioning defaults (max versions per file, cooldown period).
Duplicate upload path (replace/copy operations) still encrypts on the main thread — Phase 37 Web Worker encryption only covers new file uploads.
useDropUpload.ts has no unit tests despite being significantly rewritten in Phase 37 as the primary upload entry point.
SDK and SDK-core console.warn calls bypass Grafana Faro transport — zero-dependency constraint means structured logging doesn't cover these packages.

15 stale TEE republish entries will continue failing (ECIES decryption failure) until those clients reconnect and re-enroll with the current Phala CVM public key — DB-cached CID fallback handles resolution in the meantime.
Phala Cloud CVM is the sole TEE provider with no fallback option after Phase 35 removed the Docker simulator.
@phala/dstack-sdk single-provider lock-in risk noted in CONCERNS.md.
